{{Quote|Please place any personal weapons in the receptacle, and submit to a scan before boarding.|Esker|<ref name="Oblivion's Kiss">{{LivingForce|Oblivion's Kiss}}</ref>}}
'''Esker''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who worked as a security specialist aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|star liner]] [[White Nova (star liner)|''White Nova'']] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the ''White Nova'' traveled to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] in preparation for a voyage to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Esker and three [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] that he commanded operated a security checkpoint aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]], to search all passengers that came aboard the vessel, and he personally searched a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] that boarded the vessel, to check whether they were carrying any hidden weapons.
